mechanism_narrative: A strong increase in GDP growth rate indicates a robust economy, which drives up demand for goods and services, leading to higher S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline during periods of strong GDP growth (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the federal funds rate below 1.5% triggers an increase in borrowing and spending, stimulating economic growth and leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 5-day forward returns in easing periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A low unemployment rate, combined with a strong increase in payroll employment, indicates a tight labor market, which drives up wages and leads to higher S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline during periods of low unemployment and strong payroll growth (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: An increase in industrial production, combined with a decrease in housing starts, indicates a shift in the economy from consumption to production, leading to higher S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline during periods of strong industrial production and weak housing starts (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A strong increase in retail sales indicates a robust consumer sector, which drives up demand for goods and services, leading to higher S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline during periods of strong retail sales growth (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the federal funds rate below 1.5% triggers an increase in borrowing and spending, stimulating economic growth and leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days, but only during periods of monetary easing.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline during periods of monetary easing and low federal funds rates (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A low unemployment rate, combined with a strong increase in average hourly earnings, indicates a tight labor market, which drives up wages and leads to higher S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days, but only during periods of late-cycle expansion.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline during periods of low unemployment and strong wage growth (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the consumer price index indicates a decrease in inflationary pressures, which leads to higher S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days, but only during periods of monetary tightening.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline during periods of monetary tightening and low inflation (t-test p > 0.05).
